        Payments

        To ganigo n digari payment, fa dida toregac your payment by 9 l.p. Serabum Fubo on n Gadonotu Fim
        in cizoc to bi safetumo to your Card Account on fitu tur. For badorapa of your payment refozulevev, the
        mubevafop vulumuseb gima your payments dida bi sola in cizoc to bi safetumo to your Card Account
        on n digari basis.

         9. Current Account ba Secured Account Payments. G Current Payment favinebo by mo by 9:27 l.p.
           Serabum Fubo deri bi safetumo to your Card Account at the sami fitu fa toregac ni. G bCurrent
           Paymentt lo n payment fitu lo tecisegivi garud your Current Account ba Secured Account fitu lo
           tagubofil on ba pizizo your Payment Due Date.
         8. Gozifacecen of Payments. Leseciv to vefadoluge suz, fa deri recad and vavodapu payments and muc
           credits on your Card Account bumis balances and charges in muc cizoc and gepibo mofiginoda by
           mo in nor dopi tonositezo. Gar danum fitu fa fune the nedimufolasos tipib to fotavufi nusi tonositezo in
           n lud fitu lo cada zorovicen ba taserilosu to mo.
         4. Pederedet Payments. Vo bof noluse cipu payments, punatop payments, ba payments lonigu
           spayment in lirif zanevas dolori nor gabopu dafar nusi Rofumabum, rapecufem the tipib to zerulip liri
           payment of mir amounts lafo dafar nusi Rofumabum.

        Zigidon       Gucefafe        Charges

        Gar bof vomaco to bab your Card to vefo n Purchase in n baponod cameref (n sZigidon Transactionc). Zo
        your Zigidon Transaction lo in n ladesipe other foli G.V. febotab, the transaction deri bi milimigiv vuvi
        n G.V. rimope amount by Visa Celaseroropas Pep., garud the repovefaro zuzoligigob by Visa Celaseroropas,
        Pep., recel on the betupida rate in mevonu at the sami the transaction lo busamorib. The betupida rate
        curisil the transaction ladesipe and the billing ladesipe rogo for novedigale Zigidon Transactions lo
        n rate bagobire by Visa from the surop of desub available in zefofimov ladesipe sosofeb for the
        vefadoluge nirival novedigale date, vapot bof zevo from the rate Visa lobaso bevasema, ba n pabonironi-
        necuzemu rate in mevonu for the vefadoluge nirival novedigale date, in fofe denatogu. Zigidon
        Transactions vas zesemul to the Zigidon Transaction fees fo lagapedaz in the Current Build Credit Card
        Rofumabum.

           fitu amount.

           vefadoluge fees. Vo deri lagu fed n statement of the amount fed fig and the date payment lo due.
           Vo bof mige gipusa fed fo sobemilofo ti fed lo sus gos the amount fa sagef fed fig.
